stops.name: Parque natural de la Sierra de la Lastra
stops.detail: The Sierra de la Lasse Natural Park () () () () is a Spanish protected natural space situated in the north-eastern province of Orense, in the municipality of Rubiana, Valdeoras, and was declared a Natural Park in [dated source] by the Galicia Board. It has an area of 3151.67 ha and an average height of 684 m. It's a limestone valley with pronounced slopes and cantils with a Mediterranean forest. A particularly important area of public interest, especially for its rapist bird populations, among them the presence of the Royal Eagle and the Pereer Falcon. The abundance of caves - referred to here as shovels - leads to the existence of numerous colonies of bats, the most important of Galicia. A further point of interest lies in the presence of Mediterranean-type grazing areas characteristic of rocky mountain areas.)
